points.quote: `browser/`: core workbench UI, including parts, layout and actions. `common/`: shared code with no UI dependencies. `electron-browser/`: desktop-only renderer code.
`api/`: the extension host and the implementation of the VS Code API.
`services/`: service implementations. They are grouped per service and then split by environment layer.
`contrib/`: feature contributions such as git, debug, search, terminal, chat, notebook, scm, testing and extensions. It has about 100 feature folders.
**Contribution model:** features plug in by registering with registries and extension points ... The core doesn't call into features directly.
Each feature normally has a `*.contribution.ts` that wires this up.
